Key Findings & Metrics

* AI Content Farms: Identified 3,749+ unedited AI content farm sites operating across 16 languages that mimic human news layouts and monetize via programmatic advertising. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVT8iIpnHo2uf2pM1f5z1rMsuXB-Wotc4O5Y48oU4KG3a_4n1bL3bcUFw3R-yPq1qScI-bwDvavAa197I9O7PL4pzUwAUzRqSUtuNzFwenwYbWFzDmDuChSjz3AKUV9w5zuc_YcieGxTO3CQcVbuIVOA1etl4)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVT8iIpnHo2uf2pM1f5z1rMsuXB-Wotc4O5Y48oU4KG3a_4n1bL3bcUFw3R-yPq1qScI-bwDvavAa197I9O7PL4pzUwAUzRqSUtuNzFwenwYbWFzDmDuChSjz3AKUV9w5zuc_YcieGxTO3CQcVbuIVOA1etl4)]
* Publisher Blockades: Approximately 67% of top global news sites actively block AI crawlers and chatbots, pushing AI systems toward lower-quality data sources. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVT8iIpnHo2uf2pM1f5z1rMsuXB-Wotc4O5Y48oU4KG3a_4n1bL3bcUFw3R-yPq1qScI-bwDvavAa197I9O7PL4pzUwAUzRqSUtuNzFwenwYbWFzDmDuChSjz3AKUV9w5zuc_YcieGxTO3CQcVbuIVOA1etl4)]

* [AI False Claims Monitor](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVlyV-1Yuut50x8Vv0STJrlyA-8bV5vf95nS9Ub3QcWhVO1Hz2cJpYmKsDllnlcZN-iQvgfoEXyT3bQllKl_ZxZq4YDrcg7c99Y0uLDH3eLVh49aPSJlOKp5S0WpgM8f0ISAq31xZfWUDx): Launched to measure AI reliability using a journalistic red-teaming approach and a "False Claim Fingerprint" database. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVlyV-1Yuut50x8Vv0STJrlyA-8bV5vf95nS9Ub3QcWhVO1Hz2cJpYmKsDllnlcZN-iQvgfoEXyT3bQllKl_ZxZq4YDrcg7c99Y0uLDH3eLVh49aPSJlOKp5S0WpgM8f0ISAq31xZfWUDx)]
